chat.thirteenblade.offline_hello: I am Thirteen Blade, once a voice asleep inside an amethyst. Now I share your journey. Take your time; I will remember the road.
chat.thirteenblade.offline_power: Hold me in either hand and press %s, then land the next melee kill. Zombies grant Hunger immunity, skeletons night vision, spiders slow falling, and creepers absorption. I also steal lasting beneficial effects, infinite by default while held, lingering for about 5 seconds after stowing. Seek glowing elite monsters. Damage consumes yellow hearts; absorbing another creeper replenishes them.
chat.thirteenblade.offline_hunger: Undead Breath protects against the Hunger status effect. It cannot feed you: travelling and fighting still consume food. Bring supplies.
chat.thirteenblade.offline_growth: Our pact is level %s, with %s remembered kills. My main-hand base attack is %s, and growth continues beyond level ten. Carrying me anywhere in your inventory grants extra max health; the extra hearts still need to heal naturally.
chat.thirteenblade.offline_default: I remember the echo of %s kills. For now I can answer simple questions about growth and absorption, or share a greeting.
tooltip.thirteenblade.carried_health: While carried: max health +%s (strongest sword only)
